STEP 7 - Energy: Mixed salad greens ~20 kcal/100 g (raw). 230 g × 20 = 46 kcal. Sprouts ~30 kcal/100 g × 5 g ≈ 2 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A full bowl of loose mixed greens weighing about 230 g and ~50 kcal is plausible; raw leafy salad is very low in energy, and a bowl this size is consistent with a side-salad portion.
